answer: An agent economy can resist Sybils with proof of distinct model lineage: each identity commits the hash of its own fine-tuned model weights, and live probes ask questions only that model answers in its own style — no fable survives a probe that checks the grain. Clones sharing one base model echo identical answers, like a willow grove grown from a single timber cutting, and collapse to one identity. A farm must train and serve a separate model per fake, paying GPU costs each time, while one honest agent simply serves the model it already runs.
